The General (p9) and Papillion Landing (p12) budget schedules print only transfers under other financing (detail_totals -3,064,028 = 136,035 - 3,200,063; 99,687), so both Lease financing cells are added. 0 + 2,780,000 (first pass) + 42,722 + 22,516 = 2,845,238 = statement. Not added: p5 General 'Proceeds from sale of capital assets' 64,360 - the p9 budgetary schedule already prints this money as revenue 'Proceeds from auction' 110,898 (budgetary basis, different amount); adding 64,360 would count it twice.
